Tiger Suspected in Two Deaths Captured in Tamil Nadu

A tiger suspected of killing two people has been captured in the Gudalur area of Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris district after a 28-day search operation. Forest department officials led the operation to trap the animal, which had been declared a man-eater. The capture brings an end to the extensive search that involved multiple teams and significant resources. The tiger is now in the custody of forest officials.
